description: Fixtures for the values.md standard, version 0.1. Each entry names a path under this directory, the scope it is checked at (file, folder or collection), and the outcome a conforming checker must give: valid, invalid or unsupported-version. An invalid entry lists the rules that fail. Its details say why, in the reference checker's own codes: a short word, or for V3 and V7 the path of the constraint that rejects the input in values.schema.json or mcp.schema.json. A valid entry gives the number of characters in the body and in the core, and its directory holds expected/wrapper.txt and expected/reminder.txt, the exact texts it renders to. An entry with symlinks is built when it is run: copy the folder, then make each named link point at its target. A collection entry gives the outcome for each package folder in it.
